pairs.question: Hostis Herodes impie, Christum venire quid times?
pairs.answer: Non eripit mortalia, Qui regna dat celestia.
pairs.derivation: Authorial apostrophe to Herod: the poet asks why Herod fears Christ's coming (interrogative quid times?), then answers it himself in the following two lines (He who gives heavenly kingdoms does not snatch away mortal ones). Question keeps the vocative setup 'Hostis Herodes impie' so the addressee and 'venire' have referents. Inline verse number '30' after 'quid times?' stripped as scaffolding. Answer is the complete and only response; nothing cut. No other stanza in the hymn contains an interrogative, so no other pairs.
